speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To begin my assessment, how old is the baby in hours or days, and were there any complications during the delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS). The patient is a preterm infant born via C-section with maternal gestational diabetes, which is a classic presentation for surfactant deficiency leading to alveolar collapse and respiratory distress. No further questions or tests are needed.
